text.tspan:
Using at least basic drinking water sources in urban vs. rural areas
2024

Share of urban versus rural population using at least a basic drinking water source; that is, an
improved source
within 30 minutes round trip to collect water.
Data source: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene (2025)
Note: Where a country or region lacks data for the year shown, the closest available value within 10 years is shown instead.
